classification.difficultyReason: Identify two circumference angles formed by the endpoints of a supplied chord.

content.prompt: Name two angles subtended by chord $BX$ at the circumference.

spec.description: Circle with four circumference points and six chords; AY and BX intersect at Z. Ordinary source colours are replaced by black.
spec.mathematics: A, B, X and Y lie on the circle. Chords AX, XY, YB, BA, AY and BX are present. Z is the intersection of AY and BX.
spec.answerVisibility: No supplied answers or angle annotations appear in the question diagram.

answer.worked: $\angle XAB$ and $\angle XYB$ each have their vertex on the circumference and their arms passing through $X$ and $B$.
